verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בִּשְׁתֵּ֣י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה בִּשְׁנֵי־ עָשָׂ֥ר חֹ֖דֶשׁ בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָ֥ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî biš·tê ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh biš·nê- ‘ā·śār ḥō·ḏeš bə·’e·ḥāḏ la·ḥō·ḏeš hā·yāh ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: In the twelfth . . . year on the first day of the twelfth . . . month the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: E SUCEDEU que, no ano duodécimo, no duodécimo mês, ao primeiro do mês, veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֗ם שָׂ֤א קִינָה֙ עַל־ פַּרְעֹ֣ה מֶֽלֶךְ־ מִצְרַ֔יִם וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֵלָ֔יו כְּפִ֥יר גּוֹיִ֖ם נִדְמֵ֑יתָ וְאַתָּה֙ כַּתַּנִּ֣ים בַּיַּמִּ֔ים וַתָּ֣גַח בְּנַהֲרוֹתֶ֗יךָ וַתִּדְלַח־ מַ֙יִם֙ בְּרַגְלֶ֔יךָ וַתִּרְפֹּ֖ס נַהֲרוֹתָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām śā qî·nāh ‘al- par·‘ōh me·leḵ- miṣ·ra·yim wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ê·lāw kə·p̄îr gō·w·yim niḏ·mê·ṯā wə·’at·tāh kat·tan·nîm bay·yam·mîm wat·tā·ḡaḥ bə·na·hă·rō·w·ṯe·ḵā wat·tiḏ·laḥ- ma·yim bə·raḡ·le·ḵā wat·tir·pōs na·hă·rō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: Son of man take up a lament for Pharaoh king of Egypt and say to him You are like a lion among the nations you are like a monster in the seas You thrash about in your rivers churning up the waters with your feet and muddying the streams
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, levanta uma lamentação sobre Faraó, rei do Egito, e dize-lhe: Eras semelhante a um filho do leão entre as nações, mas tu és como uma baleia nos mares, e rompias os teus rios, e turbavas as águas com os teus pés, e pisavas os teus rios.

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה וּפָרַשְׂתִּ֤י עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ אֶת־ רִשְׁתִּ֔י בִּקְהַ֖ל עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְהֶעֱל֖וּךָ בְּחֶרְמִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ū·p̄ā·raś·tî ‘ā·le·ḵā ’eṯ- riš·tî biq·hal ‘am·mîm rab·bîm wə·he·‘ĕ·lū·ḵā bə·ḥer·mî
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says I will spread My net over you with a company of many peoples and they will draw you up in My net
verses.literalPt: Assim diz o Senhor DEUS: Portanto, estenderei sobre ti a minha rede com reunião de muitos povos, e te farão subir na minha rede.

verses.original: וּנְטַשְׁתִּ֣יךָ בָאָ֔רֶץ עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה אֲטִילֶ֑ךָ וְהִשְׁכַּנְתִּ֤י עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ כָּל־ ע֣וֹף הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם וְהִשְׂבַּעְתִּ֥י מִמְּךָ֖ חַיַּ֥ת כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·ṭaš·tî·ḵā ḇā·’ā·reṣ ‘al- pə·nê haś·śā·ḏeh ’ă·ṭî·le·ḵā wə·hiš·kan·tî ‘ā·le·ḵā kāl- ‘ō·wp̄ haš·šā·ma·yim wə·hiś·ba‘·tî mim·mə·ḵā ḥay·yaṯ kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: I will abandon you on the land and hurl you into the open field I will cause all the birds of the air to settle upon you and all the beasts of the earth to eat their fill of you
verses.literalPt: Então te deixarei em terra; sobre a face do campo te lançarei, e farei pousar sobre ti todas as aves do céu, e fartarei de ti os animais de toda a terra.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֥י אֶת־ בְּשָׂרְךָ֖ עַל־ הֶֽהָרִ֑ים וּמִלֵּאתִ֥י הַגֵּאָי֖וֹת רָמוּתֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- bə·śā·rə·ḵā ‘al- he·hā·rîm ū·mil·lê·ṯî hag·gê·’ā·yō·wṯ rā·mū·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: I will put your flesh on the mountains and fill the valleys with your remains
verses.literalPt: E porei as tuas carnes sobre os montes, e encherei os vales da tua altura.

verses.original: וְהִשְׁקֵיתִ֨י אֶ֧רֶץ צָפָתְךָ֛ מִדָּמְךָ֖ אֶל־ הֶֽהָרִ֑ים וַאֲפִקִ֖ים יִמָּלְא֥וּן מִמֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiš·qê·ṯî ’e·reṣ ṣā·p̄ā·ṯə·ḵā mid·dā·mə·ḵā ’el- he·hā·rîm wa·’ă·p̄i·qîm yim·mā·lə·’ūn mim·me·kā
verses.literal: I will drench the land with the flow of your blood all the way to the mountains the ravines will be filled
verses.literalPt: E regarei com o teu sangue a terra onde nadas, até aos montes; e os rios se encherão de ti.

verses.original: וְכִסֵּיתִ֤י בְכַבּֽוֹתְךָ֙ שָׁמַ֔יִם וְהִקְדַּרְתִּ֖י אֶת־ כֹּֽכְבֵיהֶ֑ם שֶׁ֚מֶשׁ בֶּעָנָ֣ן אֲכַסֶּ֔נּוּ וְיָרֵ֖חַ לֹא־ יָאִ֥יר אוֹרֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵis·sê·ṯî ḇə·ḵab·bō·wṯ·ḵā šā·ma·yim wə·hiq·dar·tî ’eṯ- kō·ḵə·ḇê·hem meš be·‘ā·nān ’ă·ḵas·sen·nū wə·yā·rê·aḥ lō- yā·’îr ’ō·w·rōw
verses.literal: When I extinguish you I will cover the heavens and darken their stars I will cover the sun with a cloud and the moon will not give its light . . .
verses.literalPt: E, apagando-te eu, cobrirei os céus, e enegrecerei as suas estrelas; ao sol encobrirei com uma nuvem, e a lua não fará resplandecer a sua luz.

verses.original: כָּל־ מְא֤וֹרֵי אוֹר֙ בַּשָּׁמַ֔יִם אַקְדִּירֵ֖ם עָלֶ֑יךָ וְנָתַ֤תִּי חֹ֙שֶׁךְ֙ עַֽל־ אַרְצְךָ֔ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kāl- mə·’ō·w·rê ’ō·wr baš·šā·ma·yim ’aq·dî·rêm ‘ā·le·ḵā wə·nā·ṯat·tî ḥō·šeḵ ‘al- ’ar·ṣə·ḵā nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: All the shining lights in the heavens I will darken over you and I will bring darkness upon your land declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Todas as brilhantes luzes do céu enegrecerei sobre ti, e trarei trevas sobre a tua terra, diz o Senhor DEUS.

verses.original: וְהִ֨כְעַסְתִּ֔י לֵ֖ב עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים בַּהֲבִיאִ֤י שִׁבְרְךָ֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם עַל־ אֲרָצ֖וֹת אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ יְדַעְתָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hiḵ·‘as·tî lêḇ ‘am·mîm rab·bîm ba·hă·ḇî·’î šiḇ·rə·ḵā bag·gō·w·yim ‘al- ’ă·rā·ṣō·wṯ ’ă·šer lō- yə·ḏa‘·tām
verses.literal: I will trouble the hearts of many peoples when I bring about your destruction among the nations in countries you do not know
verses.literalPt: E afligirei os corações de muitos povos, quando eu levar a tua destruição entre as nações, às terras que não conheceste.

verses.original: וַהֲשִׁמּוֹתִ֨י עָלֶ֜יךָ עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים וּמַלְכֵיהֶם֙ יִשְׂעֲר֤וּ עָלֶ֙יךָ֙ שַׂ֔עַר בְּעוֹפְפִ֥י חַרְבִּ֖י עַל־ פְּנֵיהֶ֑ם וְחָרְד֤וּ לִרְגָעִים֙ אִ֣ישׁ לְנַפְשׁ֔וֹ בְּי֖וֹם מַפַּלְתֶּֽךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·šim·mō·w·ṯî ‘ā·le·ḵā ‘am·mîm rab·bîm ū·mal·ḵê·hem yiś·‘ă·rū ‘ā·le·ḵā śa·‘ar bə·‘ō·wp̄·p̄î ḥar·bî ‘al- pə·nê·hem wə·ḥā·rə·ḏū lir·ḡā·‘îm ’îš lə·nap̄·šōw bə·yō·wm map·pal·te·ḵā
verses.literal: I will cause many peoples to be appalled over you and their kings will shudder in horror . . . because of you when I brandish My sword before them On the day of your downfall each of them will tremble every moment for his life
verses.literalPt: E farei com que muitos povos fiquem pasmados de ti, e os seus reis tremam sobremaneira, quando eu brandir a minha espada ante os seus rostos; e estremecerão a cada momento, cada um pela sua vida, no dia da tua queda.

verses.original: כִּ֛י כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה חֶ֥רֶב מֶֽלֶךְ־ בָּבֶ֖ל תְּבוֹאֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: kî kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ḥe·reḇ me·leḵ- bā·ḇel tə·ḇō·w·’e·ḵā
verses.literal: For this is what the Lord GOD says The sword of the king of Babylon will come against you
verses.literalPt: Porque assim diz o Senhor DEUS: A espada do rei de Babilônia virá sobre ti.

verses.original: בְּחַרְב֤וֹת גִּבּוֹרִים֙ אַפִּ֣יל הֲמוֹנֶ֔ךָ עָרִיצֵ֥י גוֹיִ֖ם כֻּלָּ֑ם וְשָֽׁדְדוּ֙ אֶת־ גְּא֣וֹן מִצְרַ֔יִם וְנִשְׁמַ֖ד כָּל־ הֲמוֹנָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḥar·ḇō·wṯ gib·bō·w·rîm ’ap·pîl hă·mō·w·ne·ḵā ‘ā·rî·ṣê ḡō·w·yim kul·lām wə·šā·ḏə·ḏū ’eṯ- gə·’ō·wn miṣ·ra·yim wə·niš·maḏ kāl- hă·mō·w·nāh
verses.literal: I will make your hordes fall by the swords of the mighty the most ruthless of all nations They will ravage the pride of Egypt and all her multitudes will be destroyed
verses.literalPt: Farei cair a tua multidão pelas espadas dos poderosos, que são todos os mais terríveis das nações; e destruirão a soberba do Egito, e toda a sua multidão será destruída.

verses.original: וְהַֽאֲבַדְתִּי֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ בְּהֶמְתָּ֔הּ מֵעַ֖ל מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים וְלֹ֨א תִדְלָחֵ֤ם רֶֽגֶל־ אָדָם֙ ע֔וֹד וּפַרְס֥וֹת בְּהֵמָ֖ה לֹ֥א תִדְלָחֵֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ha·’ă·ḇaḏ·tî ’eṯ- kāl- bə·hem·tāh mê·‘al ma·yim rab·bîm wə·lō ṯiḏ·lā·ḥêm re·ḡel- ’ā·ḏām ‘ō·wḏ ū·p̄ar·sō·wṯ bə·hê·māh lō ṯiḏ·lā·ḥêm
verses.literal: I will slaughter all her cattle beside the abundant waters No human foot will muddy them again and no cattle hooves will disturb them
verses.literalPt: E exterminarei todos os seus animais sobre as muitas águas; nem as turbará mais pé de homem, nem as turbarão unhas de animais.

verses.original: אָ֚ז אַשְׁקִ֣יעַ מֵֽימֵיהֶ֔ם וְנַהֲרוֹתָ֖ם כַּשֶּׁ֣מֶן אוֹלִ֑יךְ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’āz ’aš·qî·a‘ mê·mê·hem wə·na·hă·rō·w·ṯām kaš·še·men ’ō·w·lîḵ nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: Then I will let her waters settle and will make her rivers flow like oil declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Então farei assentar as suas águas, e farei correr os seus rios como o azeite, diz o Senhor DEUS.

verses.original: בְּתִתִּי֩ אֶת־ אֶ֨רֶץ מִצְרַ֜יִם שְׁמָמָ֣ה וּנְשַׁמָּ֗ה אֶ֚רֶץ מִמְּלֹאָ֔הּ בְּהַכּוֹתִ֖י אֶת־ כָּל־ י֣וֹשְׁבֵי בָ֑הּ וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṯit·tî ’eṯ- ’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim šə·mā·māh ū·nə·šam·māh ’e·reṣ mim·mə·lō·’āh bə·hak·kō·w·ṯî ’eṯ- kāl- yō·wō·šə·ḇê ḇāh wə·yā·ḏə·‘ū kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: When I make the land of Egypt a desolation and empty it of all that filled it when I strike down all who live there then they will know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Quando eu tornar a terra do Egito em desolação, e ela for despojada da sua plenitude, e quando ferir a todos os que habitam nela, então saberão que eu sou o SENHOR.

verses.original: קִינָ֥ה הִיא֙ וְק֣וֹנְנ֔וּהָ בְּנ֥וֹת הַגּוֹיִ֖ם תְּקוֹנֵ֣נָּה אוֹתָ֑הּ עַל־ מִצְרַ֤יִם וְעַל־ כָּל־ הֲמוֹנָהּ֙ תְּקוֹנֵ֣נָּה אוֹתָ֔הּ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: qî·nāh hî wə·qō·wn·nū·hā bə·nō·wṯ hag·gō·w·yim tə·qō·w·nên·nāh ’ō·w·ṯāh ‘al- miṣ·ra·yim wə·‘al- kāl- hă·mō·w·nāh tə·qō·w·nên·nāh ’ō·w·ṯāh nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: This is the lament they will chant for her the daughters of the nations will chant it Over Egypt . . . and all her multitudes they will chant it declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Esta é a lamentação que se fará; que as filhas das nações farão; sobre o Egito e sobre toda a sua multidão, diz o Senhor DEUS.

verses.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ בִּשְׁתֵּ֣י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה בַּחֲמִשָּׁ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ הָיָ֥ה דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî biš·tê ‘eś·rêh šā·nāh ba·ḥă·miš·šāh ‘ā·śār la·ḥō·ḏeš hā·yāh ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: In the twelfth . . . year on the fifteenth . . . day of the month . . . the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, no ano duodécimo, aos quinze do mês, veio a mim a palavra do SENHOR, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֕ם נְהֵ֛ה עַל־ הֲמ֥וֹן מִצְרַ֖יִם וְהוֹרִדֵ֑הוּ א֠וֹתָהּ וּבְנ֨וֹת גּוֹיִ֧ם אַדִּרִ֛ם אֶל־ אֶ֥רֶץ תַּחְתִּיּ֖וֹת אֶת־ י֥וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām nə·hêh ‘al- hă·mō·wn miṣ·ra·yim wə·hō·w·ri·ḏê·hū ’ō·w·ṯāh ū·ḇə·nō·wṯ gō·w·yim ’ad·di·rim ’el- ’e·reṣ taḥ·tî·yō·wṯ ’eṯ- yō·wr·ḏê ḇō·wr
verses.literal: Son of man wail for the multitudes of Egypt and consign her and the daughters of the mighty nations to the depths of the earth with those who descend to the Pit
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, pranteia sobre a multidão do Egito, e faze-a descer, a ela e às filhas das nações magníficas, às partes mais baixas da terra, juntamente com os que descem à cova.

verses.original: מִמִּ֖י נָעָ֑מְתָּ רְדָ֥ה וְהָשְׁכְּבָ֖ה אֶת־ עֲרֵלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: mim·mî nā·‘ā·mə·tā rə·ḏāh wə·hā·šə·kə·ḇāh ’eṯ- ‘ă·rê·lîm
verses.literal: Whom do you surpass in beauty Go down and be placed with the uncircumcised
verses.literalPt: A quem sobrepujas tu em formosura? Desce, e deita-te com os incircuncisos.

verses.original: בְּת֥וֹךְ חַלְלֵי־ חֶ֖רֶב יִפֹּ֑לוּ חֶ֣רֶב נִתָּ֔נָה מָשְׁכ֥וּ אוֹתָ֖הּ וְכָל־ הֲמוֹנֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṯō·wḵ ḥal·lê- ḥe·reḇ yip·pō·lū ḥe·reḇ nit·tā·nāh mā·šə·ḵū ’ō·w·ṯāh wə·ḵāl hă·mō·w·ne·hā
verses.literal: They will fall among those slain by the sword The sword is appointed Let them drag her away along with all her multitudes
verses.literalPt: No meio daqueles que foram mortos à espada cairão; à espada ela está entregue; arrastai-a e a toda a sua multidão.

verses.original: יְדַבְּרוּ־ ל֞וֹ אֵלֵ֧י גִבּוֹרִ֛ים מִתּ֥וֹךְ שְׁא֖וֹל אֶת־ עֹֽזְרָ֑יו יָֽרְד֛וּ שָׁכְב֥וּ הָעֲרֵלִ֖ים חַלְלֵי־ חָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: yə·ḏab·bə·rū- lōw ’ê·lê ḡib·bō·w·rîm mit·tō·wḵ šə·’ō·wl ’eṯ- ‘ō·zə·rāw yā·rə·ḏū šā·ḵə·ḇū hā·‘ă·rê·lîm ḥal·lê- ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: Mighty chiefs will speak from the midst of Sheol about Egypt and her allies They have come down and lie with the uncircumcised with those slain by the sword
verses.literalPt: Os mais poderosos dos fortes lhe falarão desde o meio do inferno, com os que a socorrem; desceram, jazeram com os incircuncisos mortos à espada.

verses.original: שָׁ֤ם אַשּׁוּר֙ וְכָל־ קְהָלָ֔הּ סְבִֽיבוֹתָ֖יו קִבְרֹתָ֑יו כֻּלָּ֣ם חֲלָלִ֔ים הַנֹּפְלִ֖ים בֶּחָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: šām ’aš·šūr wə·ḵāl qə·hā·lāh sə·ḇî·ḇō·w·ṯāw qiḇ·rō·ṯāw kul·lām ḥă·lā·lîm han·nō·p̄ə·lîm be·ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: Assyria is there with her whole company her graves are all around her All of them are slain fallen by the sword
verses.literalPt: Ali está Assur com toda a sua multidão; em redor dele estão os seus sepulcros; todos eles mortos, abatidos à espada.

verses.original: אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִתְּנ֤וּ קִבְרֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ בְּיַרְכְּתֵי־ ב֔וֹר וַיְהִ֣י קְהָלָ֔הּ סְבִיב֖וֹת קְבֻרָתָ֑הּ כֻּלָּ֤ם חֲלָלִים֙ נֹפְלִ֣ים בַּחֶ֔רֶב אֲשֶׁר־ נָתְנ֥וּ חִתִּ֖ית בְּאֶ֥רֶץ חַיִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·šer nit·tə·nū qiḇ·rō·ṯe·hā bə·yar·kə·ṯê- ḇō·wr way·hî qə·hā·lāh sə·ḇî·ḇō·wṯ qə·ḇu·rā·ṯāh kul·lām ḥă·lā·lîm nō·p̄ə·lîm ba·ḥe·reḇ ’ă·šer- nā·ṯə·nū ḥit·tîṯ bə·’e·reṣ ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: Her graves are set in the depths of the Pit and her company is all around her grave All of them are slain fallen by the sword those who once spread terror in the land of the living
verses.literalPt: Os seus sepulcros foram postos nas extremidades da cova, e a sua multidão está em redor do seu sepulcro; todos eles mortos, abatidos à espada; os que tinham causado espanto na terra dos viventes.

verses.original: שָׁ֤ם עֵילָם֙ וְכָל־ הֲמוֹנָ֔הּ סְבִיב֖וֹת קְבֻרָתָ֑הּ כֻּלָּ֣ם חֲלָלִים֩ הַנֹּפְלִ֨ים בַּחֶ֜רֶב אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ יָרְד֥וּ עֲרֵלִ֣ים׀ אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ תַּחְתִּיּ֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֨ר נָתְנ֤וּ חִתִּיתָם֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּ֔ים וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ כְלִמָּתָ֖ם אֶת־ י֥וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: šām ‘ê·lām wə·ḵāl hă·mō·w·nāh sə·ḇî·ḇō·wṯ qə·ḇu·rā·ṯāh kul·lām ḥă·lā·lîm han·nō·p̄ə·lîm ba·ḥe·reḇ ’ăšer- yā·rə·ḏū ‘ă·rê·lîm ’el- ’e·reṣ taḥ·tî·yō·wṯ ’ă·šer nā·ṯə·nū ḥit·tî·ṯām bə·’e·reṣ ḥay·yîm way·yiś·’ū ḵə·lim·mā·ṯām ’eṯ- yō·wr·ḏê ḇō·wr
verses.literal: Elam is there with all her multitudes around her grave All of them are slain fallen by the sword those who went down uncircumcised to the earth below who once spread their terror in the land of the living They bear their disgrace with those who descend to the Pit
verses.literalPt: Ali está Elão com toda a sua multidão em redor do seu sepulcro; todos eles mortos, abatidos à espada; desceram incircuncisos às partes mais baixas da terra, causaram terror na terra dos viventes e levaram a sua vergonha com os que desceram à cova.

verses.original: בְּת֣וֹךְ חֲ֠לָלִים נָתְנ֨וּ מִשְׁכָּ֥ב לָהּ֙ בְּכָל־ הֲמוֹנָ֔הּ סְבִֽיבוֹתָ֖יו קִבְרֹתֶ֑הָ כֻּלָּ֣ם עֲרֵלִ֣ים חַלְלֵי־ חֶ֡רֶב כִּֽי־ נִתַּ֨ן חִתִּיתָ֜ם בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּ֗ים וַיִּשְׂא֤וּ כְלִמָּתָם֙ אֶת־ י֣וֹרְדֵי ב֔וֹר בְּת֥וֹךְ חֲלָלִ֖ים נִתָּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṯō·wḵ ḥă·lā·lîm nā·ṯə·nū miš·kāḇ lāh bə·ḵāl hă·mō·w·nāh sə·ḇî·ḇō·w·ṯāw qiḇ·rō·ṯe·hā kul·lām ‘ă·rê·lîm ḥal·lê- ḥe·reḇ kî- nit·tan ḥit·tî·ṯām bə·’e·reṣ ḥay·yîm way·yiś·’ū ḵə·lim·mā·ṯām ’eṯ- yō·wr·ḏê ḇō·wr bə·ṯō·wḵ ḥă·lā·lîm nit·tān
verses.literal: Among the slain they prepare a resting place for Elam with all her hordes with her graves all around her All of them are uncircumcised slain by the sword although their terror was once spread in the land of the living They bear their disgrace with those who descend to the Pit They are placed among the slain
verses.literalPt: No meio dos mortos lhe puseram uma cama, entre toda a sua multidão; ao redor dele estão os seus sepulcros; todos eles são incircuncisos, mortos à espada; porque causaram terror na terra dos viventes, e levaram a sua vergonha com os que desceram à cova; foi posto no meio dos mortos.

verses.original: שָׁ֣ם מֶ֤שֶׁךְ תֻּבַל֙ וְכָל־ הֲמוֹנָ֔הּ סְבִֽיבוֹתָ֖יו קִבְרוֹתֶ֑יהָ כֻּלָּ֤ם עֲרֵלִים֙ מְחֻ֣לְלֵי חֶ֔רֶב כִּֽי־ נָתְנ֥וּ חִתִּיתָ֖ם בְּאֶ֥רֶץ חַיִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: šām me·šeḵ tu·ḇal wə·ḵāl hă·mō·w·nāh sə·ḇî·ḇō·w·ṯāw qiḇ·rō·w·ṯe·hā kul·lām ‘ă·rê·lîm mə·ḥul·lê ḥe·reḇ kî- nā·ṯə·nū ḥit·tî·ṯām bə·’e·reṣ ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: Meshech and Tubal are there with all their multitudes with their graves all around them All of them are uncircumcised slain by the sword because they spread their terror in the land of the living
verses.literalPt: Ali estão Meseque, Tubal e toda a sua multidão; ao redor deles estão os seus sepulcros; todos eles são incircuncisos, e mortos à espada, porquanto causaram terror na terra dos viventes.

verses.original: וְלֹ֤א יִשְׁכְּבוּ֙ אֶת־ גִּבּוֹרִ֔ים נֹפְלִ֖ים מֵעֲרֵלִ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָרְדֽוּ־ שְׁא֣וֹל בִּכְלֵֽי־ מִלְחַמְתָּם֩ וַיִּתְּנ֨וּ אֶת־ חַרְבוֹתָ֜ם תַּ֣חַת רָאשֵׁיהֶ֗ם וַתְּהִ֤י עֲוֺֽנֹתָם֙ עַל־ עַצְמוֹתָ֔ם כִּֽי־ חִתִּ֥ית גִּבּוֹרִ֖ים בְּאֶ֥רֶץ חַיִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō yiš·kə·ḇū ’eṯ- gib·bō·w·rîm nō·p̄ə·lîm mê·‘ă·rê·lîm ’ă·šer yā·rə·ḏū- šə·’ō·wl biḵ·lê- mil·ḥam·tām way·yit·tə·nū ’eṯ- ḥar·ḇō·w·ṯām ta·ḥaṯ rā·šê·hem wat·tə·hî ‘ă·wō·nō·ṯām ‘al- ‘aṣ·mō·w·ṯām kî- ḥit·tîṯ gib·bō·w·rîm bə·’e·reṣ ḥay·yîm
verses.literal: They do not lie down with the fallen warriors of old who went down to Sheol with their weapons of war whose swords were placed under their heads whose shields rested on their bones although the terror of the mighty was once in the land of the living
verses.literalPt: Porém não jazerão com os poderosos que caíram dos incircuncisos, os quais desceram ao inferno com as suas armas de guerra e puseram as suas espadas debaixo das suas cabeças; e a sua iniqüidade está sobre os seus ossos, porquanto eram o terror dos fortes na terra dos viventes.

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֗ה בְּת֧וֹךְ עֲרֵלִ֛ים תִּשָּׁבַ֥ר וְתִשְׁכַּ֖ב אֶת־ חַלְלֵי־ חָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh bə·ṯō·wḵ ‘ă·rê·lîm tiš·šā·ḇar wə·ṯiš·kaḇ ’eṯ- ḥal·lê- ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: But you too will be shattered and lie down among the uncircumcised with those slain by the sword
verses.literalPt: Também tu serás quebrado no meio dos incircuncisos, e jazerás com os que foram mortos à espada.

verses.original: שָׁ֣מָּה אֱד֗וֹם מְלָכֶ֙יהָ֙ וְכָל־ נְשִׂיאֶ֔יהָ אֲשֶׁר־ נִתְּנ֥וּ בִגְבוּרָתָ֖ם אֶת־ חַלְלֵי־ חָ֑רֶב הֵ֛מָּה אֶת־ עֲרֵלִ֥ים יִשְׁכָּ֖בוּ וְאֶת־ יֹ֥רְדֵי בֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: šām·māh ’ĕ·ḏō·wm mə·lā·ḵe·hā wə·ḵāl nə·śî·’e·hā ’ă·šer- nit·tə·nū ḇiḡ·ḇū·rā·ṯām ’eṯ- ḥal·lê- ḥā·reḇ hêm·māh ’eṯ- ‘ă·rê·lîm yiš·kā·ḇū wə·’eṯ- yō·rə·ḏê ḇō·wr
verses.literal: Edom is there and all her kings and princes who despite their might are laid among those slain by the sword They lie down with the uncircumcised with those who descend to the Pit
verses.literalPt: Ali está Edom, os seus reis e todos os seus príncipes, que com o seu poder foram postos com os que foram mortos à espada; estes jazem com os incircuncisos e com os que desceram à cova.

verses.original: שָׁ֣מָּה נְסִיכֵ֥י צָפ֛וֹן כֻּלָּ֖ם וְכָל־ צִֽדֹנִ֑י אֲשֶׁר־ יָרְד֣וּ אֶת־ חֲלָלִ֗ים בְּחִתִּיתָ֤ם מִגְבֽוּרָתָם֙ בּוֹשִׁ֔ים וַיִּשְׁכְּב֤וּ עֲרֵלִים֙ אֶת־ חַלְלֵי־ חֶ֔רֶב וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ כְלִמָּתָ֖ם אֶת־ י֥וֹרְדֵי בֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: šām·māh nə·sî·ḵê ṣā·p̄ō·wn kul·lām wə·ḵāl ṣi·ḏō·nî ’ă·šer- yā·rə·ḏū ’eṯ- ḥă·lā·lîm bə·ḥit·tî·ṯām miḡ·ḇū·rā·ṯām bō·wō·šîm way·yiš·kə·ḇū ‘ă·rê·lîm ’eṯ- ḥal·lê- ḥe·reḇ way·yiś·’ū ḵə·lim·mā·ṯām ’eṯ- yō·wr·ḏê ḇō·wr
verses.literal: All the leaders of the north and all the Sidonians are there they went down in disgrace with the slain despite the terror of their might They lie uncircumcised with those slain by the sword and bear their shame with those who descend to the Pit
verses.literalPt: Ali estão os príncipes do norte, todos eles, e todos os sidônios, que desceram com os mortos, envergonhados com o terror causado pelo seu poder; e jazem incircuncisos com os que foram mortos à espada, e levam a sua vergonha com os que desceram à cova.

verses.original: אוֹתָם֙ יִרְאֶ֣ה פַרְעֹ֔ה וְנִחַ֖ם עַל־ כָּל־ הֲמוֹנֹה חַלְלֵי־ חֶ֙רֶב֙ פַּרְעֹ֣ה וְכָל־ חֵיל֔וֹ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ō·w·ṯām yir·’eh p̄ar·‘ōh wə·ni·ḥam ‘al- kāl- hă·mō·nōh ḥal·lê- ḥe·reḇ par·‘ōh wə·ḵāl ḥê·lōw nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: Pharaoh will see them and be comforted over all his multitude Pharaoh and all his army slain by the sword declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Faraó os verá, e se consolará com toda a sua multidão; sim, o próprio Faraó, e todo o seu exército, mortos à espada, diz o Senhor DEUS.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ נָתַ֥תִּי אֶת־ חִתִּיתוֹ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חַיִּ֑ים וְהֻשְׁכַּב֩ בְּת֨וֹךְ עֲרֵלִ֜ים אֶת־ חַלְלֵי־ חֶ֗רֶב פַּרְעֹה֙ וְכָל־ הֲמוֹנֹ֔ה נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî- nā·ṯat·tî ’eṯ- ḥit·tī·ṯō bə·’e·reṣ ḥay·yîm wə·huš·kaḇ bə·ṯō·wḵ ‘ă·rê·lîm ’eṯ- ḥal·lê- ḥe·reḇ par·‘ōh wə·ḵāl hă·mō·nōh nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: For I will spread My terror in the land of the living so that Pharaoh and all his multitude will be laid to rest among the uncircumcised with those slain by the sword declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Porque também eu pus o meu espanto na terra dos viventes; por isso jazerá no meio dos incircuncisos, com os mortos à espada, Faraó e toda a sua multidão, diz o Senhor DEUS.
